name: composition_view
description: Flattened analytics view: one row per promoted first-class Composition persisted by this project. Document-level metadata only (status, type, category, subject/encounter/author/custodian reference keys, date, title) — no section/nested clinical content, which is promoted to its own first-class resources and covered by the other views (FR-005, Principle VI). Default column set is an informed, reviewable default (FR-005), not a finalized analytics-team contract.

where.description: Scope the view to Compositions persisted by this project's processor (FR-008): match this processor's provenance tag (processed-by = ecr-fhir-processor), version-agnostic. Excludes unrelated Composition resources on the same server.
